title: Bounds for the binomial tail recurrence
statement: Let $D$ be a natural number with $1\le D$, and define $T_D(m,0)=0$, $T_D(0,j+1)=1$, and $T_D(m+1,j+1)=T_D(m,j)/D+(1-1/D)T_D(m,j+1)$. For every pair of natural numbers $m,j$, one has $0\le T_D(m,j)\le 1$.
